source: https://github.com/JeanCarlos14301/FacturaYa (evaluation/expected-findings.json, evidence paths rebased from samples/facturaya-v1/ to the sample root)

findings.title: Concatenated SQL in invoice search

evidence.fragment: sql = "SELECT id, number, issue_date, total FROM invoices WHERE owner_id = "

findings.explanation: The 'q' query parameter is directly interpolated into raw SQL in the invoice search route without parameterization.
findings.verification_method: Legacy test retrieves other users' records using a SQL injection expression.

findings.title: Monolithic route handler with mixed concerns
findings.explanation: The route validates input, performs discount calculations, executes database transactions, and generates HTML in a single 155-line function.
findings.verification_method: AST inspection and invoice creation test.

findings.title: Duplicated discount rule with diverging rounding behavior
findings.explanation: Billing rounds the overall discount on the subtotal once; reporting rounds line-item discounts individually before summing.
findings.verification_method: Invoice FY-00001 yields a 7.51 billed discount and a 7.50 reported discount.

findings.title: Hardcoded synthetic secrets in configuration
findings.explanation: Demonstration secret keys and payment gateway credentials are hardcoded as module constants.

findings.title: Deferred cyclic dependency between billing and customers
findings.explanation: billing.py imports customers.py at module level, while customers.py imports billing.py inside invoice_count_for_customer.
findings.verification_method: Import inspection and customer invoice count test.

findings.title: Invoice JSON endpoint lacks resource owner authorization (BOLA)
findings.explanation: The JSON endpoint verifies authentication but does not check owner_id against the active session user.
findings.verification_method: Legacy test authenticates as bruno and successfully retrieves invoice 1 owned by ana with status 200.

findings.title: Correctly parameterized customer email query

evidence.fragment: SELECT id, owner_id, name, email FROM customers WHERE email = ?

findings.explanation: The customer email parameter is properly bound via a placeholder and not concatenated into SQL.
findings.verification_method: Test passes a SQL injection expression as email and retrieves no rows.
